title: Seal session stream frames
responsibility: Derive one key per session stream and seal or open output frames with counter nonces and an authenticated header.

inputs.name: sealedFrameHeader.frame
inputs.description: Encoded frame from which to read the versioned header.

inputs.name: sealedStreamKey.keys
inputs.description: Scope keys used to derive the session stream key.

inputs.name: sealedStreamKey.streamId
inputs.description: Identifier of the stream to bind to the derived key.

inputs.name: sealedFrame.keys
inputs.description: Scope identity and epoch to bind to the frame header.

inputs.name: sealedFrame.streamKey
inputs.description: Derived key for this frame's stream.

inputs.name: sealedFrame.frame
inputs.type: { streamId: Uint8Array; counter: bigint; data: Uint8Array }
inputs.description: Stream identifier, frame counter, and bytes to encrypt.

inputs.name: openSealedFrame.keys
inputs.description: Scope identity and epoch expected in the frame header.

inputs.name: openSealedFrame.streamKey
inputs.description: Derived key for the stream identified by the frame.

inputs.name: openSealedFrame.frame
inputs.description: Encoded frame to authenticate and decrypt.

outputs.name: sealedFrameHeader
outputs.description: Parsed frame header. Opening the frame authenticates its header.

outputs.name: sealedStreamKey
outputs.description: Derived symmetric key for the specified stream.

outputs.name: sealedFrame
outputs.description: Encoded header followed by the authenticated ciphertext.

outputs.name: openSealedFrame
outputs.description: Authenticated header and original output bytes.

errors.name: SealedError
errors.description: The header, counter, or stream identifier is invalid, the scope does not match, or authentication fails.
